resources.string: Have a question, request or problem? Contact your administrator.
Hello, I have a question about YiDream.
WhatsApp opens in an external app or browser. You choose the message and confirm sending it.

Using YiDream

YiDream manages the permitted applications and website requests on your device according to your administrator’s settings.

The catalog updates installed apps approved for your device. An approved website request does not automatically change network filtering.

Removing the filter remains protected by the removal code. Contact your administrator to learn which rules apply to your device.

WhatsApp and your email app are external services. YiDream does not automatically send them a message or device identifier.

This information describes how to use the app. Contact your administrator for the service’s contractual terms and privacy policy.
You can contact your administrator on WhatsApp at %1$s or by email at %2$s.
